svg.text: Tell me the songs you love, the ones you cannot stand,
and the tracks already tied to the ceremony. I’ll build
the rest and mix it live.
Songs, microphones, and timing are confirmed before anyone walks.
Familiar records, room to talk, no sleepy background playlist.
I watch what stays busy, what clears space, and what brings people back.

g.text: A long playlist tells me where your taste lives.
Most songs won’t play front to back.
built a little at a time.
